semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Matesy GmbH provides specialized magnetic testing and visualization solutions relevant to semiconductor manufacturing and quality assurance.
summary: Matesy GmbH specializes in magnetic testing, magnetic field visualization, and torque testing, providing critical solutions for quality assurance and process optimization in the semiconductor industry. Their offerings include magneto-optical sensors, custom permanent magnets, and YIG products, supported by a strong scientific foundation and global distribution network.
